title: Enable fork automatic update releases
description: Standalone builds of logixism/Vencord use the existing upstream HTTP updater, but the fork has no releases because the inherited build workflow only publishes for Vendicated/Vencord. Restore publication of updater-compatible devbuild releases for this fork without changing its update source to upstream.
acceptance_criteria: The main-branch workflow supports initial release creation and subsequent asset replacement, manual dispatch, release-write permissions, and serialized publishing. Desktop and web standalone builds succeed. Native updater detection and installation work with published assets for both Discord and Vesktop. Document standalone versus Git updater behavior.
close_reason: Fixed .github/workflows/build.yml to publish updater-compatible devbuild releases for the fork, bootstrap the first release, enable main-only manual runs, grant contents write, and serialize publications. Preserved the upstream-only builds mirror and documented fork updates in README.md. Desktop/web standalone builds and plugin metadata generation passed. Real gh CLI against an isolated HTTPS release API fixture successfully created and replaced releases; the actual native updater reproduced the pre-publication 404, then installed 10 assets byte-for-byte for each Discord/Vesktop target and reported no update for the current build. Fixture stopped and removed. No live release was published; deployment requires pushing the workflow to main.
